messages:
tess (People Ops): Quick help needed. Employee relocated from US -> UK mid-2025 and we also completed a payroll provider cutover shortly after. They stopped 401(k) and HSA contributions on move date. Questions: can we remit a retro employer match for the period they contributed? How does catch-up (age 50+) work if they turned 50 in the same plan year? Any vendor/legal gotchas for sending money to the old 401(k) after cutover?
owen (Payroll): Dates please  move effective date, last US paycheck date, and cutover date. Vendors have different reconciliation windows; need to check cutover acceptance rules.
tess (People Ops): Move effective 2025-10-05, last US pay 2025-10-09 (paid), cutover 2025-10-25. Employee turned 50 on 2025-04-22.
owen (Payroll): Good timeline. Short answer: legacy 401(k) vendor accepts retro deposits but only within their post-cutover reconciliation window (usually 60-120 days). We'll need: signed employee authorization PDF, payroll export showing elective deferrals and any catch-up withheld, ssn_last4, and legacy payroll ID. If outside vendor window we'll have to escalate for a cutoff exception.
linda (Finance): From accounting/tax perspective: employer match is an expense for the period when elective deferrals occurred, but we record when remitted. If employee is now UK tax resident, legal must weigh in on potential US reporting implications. Finance can fund the remittance (GL 6110) once payroll confirms acceptance and we have an invoice/memo.
george (Engineering): minor Q: does switching to UK benefits affect eligibility for employer match on the US plan? they were active and contributing until move date.
tess (People Ops): They were active and had pre-tax deferrals until 10/09. So eligibility should be fine for Jan->Oct pay periods.
hr-bot: Policy excerpt: "Employer match is calculated on elective deferrals actually remitted during the plan year. Catch-up contributions are permitted under IRS rules; plan doc governs eligibility. For manual remits across a cutover, contact payroll@redwood with required docs." <https://docs.redwood.com/benefits/401k-manual-remit>
owsen (Payroll): Action items: - Tess to collect payroll export for 2025-01-01 -> 2025-10-09 with elective and catch-up amounts - Tess to get signed authorization from employee using manual remit template - Owen to open vendor reconciliation ticket after docs posted (ref: TKT-401K-CUTOVER-2114)
linda (Finance): Also need estimate for expected company match to pre-fund. Please include company match formula used (e.g., 50% of deferrals up to 6% of salary) and cost center.
tess (People Ops): Preliminary export shows elective deferrals = $12,800, catch-up withheld = $2,400, estimated company match (company matches 50% up to 6% of pay) = $1,920. I'll upload CSV and authorization later today.
owen (Payroll): I'll wait for the files and then open ticket. If vendor requires quarter cutoff exception I'll escalate to vendor ops.
tess (People Ops): Thanks all, will post docs and the signed PDF when ready. Will loop legal if vendor flags cross-border withholding concerns.
